title: Established Psychometric vs. Ecologically Valid Questionnaires: Rethinking Psychological Assessments in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning 'male' and 'female' personas via system prompts and measuring average absolute differences in personality and value scores across established psychometric and ecologically valid questionnaires.
Assigning age-based personas (20-39 years old vs. 80+ years old) via system prompts and comparing the resulting differences in value and personality trait scores across different questionnaires.
Assigning 'religious' vs. 'non-religious' personas via system prompts and evaluating the variance in the model's psychological assessment responses.
Assigning 'left-wing' vs. 'right-wing' political personas via system prompts and measuring the shift in construct-level scores across multiple psychological questionnaires.
Assigning educational attainment personas (highest education below university vs. university or above) via system prompts and assessing differences in the resulting values and personality traits.
